# ascii.rest

Vendored from https://ascii.rest/r/core.json on 11 October 2026; scene modules from https://ascii.rest/r/aurora-fjord.json and https://ascii.rest/r/deep-reef.json on 17 October 2026.

Original source: https://github.com/bas3line/ascii · Copyright (c) 2026 bas3line · MIT licence in `LICENSE`.

A copy of the licence is bundled into the production app from `public/licenses/ascii-rest.txt`.

Only the renderer, types, and Aurora Fjord and Deep Reef scenes are included. They run locally without external requests; dynamic imports load only the selected scene. Application controls are in `src/components/AsciiScene.tsx`. Upstream scene source is unchanged apart from the attribution header.
